faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about Cryptogen.
faq.q1: How long does the KYC verification take?
faq.a1: Our KYC process typically takes less than 5 minutes. Most verifications are completed instantly, though some may require up to 24 hours for manual review.
faq.a2: We support over 20 major cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, BNB, Solana, and many more. We regularly add new assets based on user demand.
faq.q3: How secure is my crypto on your platform?
faq.a3: We use bank-level 256-bit SSL encryption, cold storage for the majority of assets, and multi-signature technology. Your funds are protected by industry-leading security measures.
faq.q4: What are the fees for using Cryptogen?
faq.a4: We believe in transparency. There are no hidden fees. All transaction fees are clearly displayed before you confirm any operation. Account management is free.
faq.q5: Can I access my account from anywhere?
faq.a5: Yes! Cryptogen is accessible 24/7 from any device. Our platform is fully responsive and works on desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.
